chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Al-Fuḍayl, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
He looked at the people circumambulating around the Kaʿbah and said: “This is how they used to circumambulate in the Jāhiliyyah.”
They were only commanded to circumambulate it, then depart toward us, so that they may inform us of their wilayah and their affection, and present to us their support.
Then he recited this verse: “So make hearts among the people incline toward them.”

key_terms.أَفْئِدَةً: hearts, referring to inner inclination and devotion
key_terms.الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: the pre-Islamic age of ignorance contrasted here with divinely guided worship
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Sacred House around which tawaf is performed
key_terms.تَهْوِي: incline, yearn, or turn with longing
key_terms.نُصْرَتَهُمْ: their support and readiness to aid
key_terms.وَلَايَتَهُمْ: their allegiance and acknowledged authority toward the Imam and Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.يَطُوفُونَ: they circumambulate the Kaʿbah as part of the hajj rite

ai.seo_question: After completing tawaf and the rites of hajj, what are people meant to do according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the rites of tawaf as not merely a physical act of worship, but as one that must be joined with turning toward the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام in wilayah, محبت, and support. It cites the Quranic phrase about hearts inclining toward them as indicating a divinely intended orientation of the believers toward the rightful religious authority.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘Heasws looked at the people performing Tawaaf around the Kabah, so heasws said: ‘This is how they used to circle around during the Pre-Islamic period.

But rather, they have been Commanded that they should circle with it, then they should hasten towards us<sup>asws</sup> so they should let us<sup>asws</sup> know of their Wilayah and their cordiality, and they should present their help for us<sup>asws</sup>’.
Then heasws recited this Verse [14:37] therefore make the hearts of some people yearn towards them’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ’Udhayna from Fudayl who has said the following. “abu Ja‘far (a.s.)
looked at the people perform Tawaf (walking around the Ka‘ba seven times) and said, “This is how they used to perform Tawaf in the times ignorance (pre-Islamic era).
What they are required to do is to perform Tawaf and come to us, declare their support and love for us and express their help for us.
The Imam (a.s.) then recited this verse of the Holy Quran. “Lord, fill the hearts of the people with love for them . .” [14:37]
